title: 第1484章 灵魂觉醒第1483章 一锅端
slug: 陆地键仙第1488章真神黄昏
lines: 卢植心想我女儿早就一腔情丝系在他身上了，要不是我阻止，恐怕早就私订终身了。
玄德这家伙到底有什么魔力……
当然他脸上没有表露出来，反倒笑眯眯说道：“姐妹俩相中一人，未来史书上也不失为一段佳话。”
乔玄脸色难看，瞪了两个女儿一眼，让她们先回内宅。
姐妹俩跟祖安重逢，心情相当好，倒也没再顶撞父亲。
乔玄看了祖安一眼，这才拉着卢植到书房商议。
大厅之中只剩下了祖安和周瑜二人。
祖安心中一动，主动搭讪：“孙家父子已经走了，公瑾留在这里是等我么？”
“你这家伙脸皮倒是厚，”周瑜笑了笑，“你怎么知道是我。”
祖安笑道：“之前你说过会化身万千，成为辅助各方势力的智谋之士，孙家父子身边自然非周瑜莫属了。”
眼前这家伙自然是智慧之神的化身之一了。
“不错，我确实是留下来跟你说说话的，大小乔竟然都相中了你，看来你果然气运非凡，说不定之前说的那件事真的要成功在你身上。”周瑜感慨道。
“既然如此，不如你我一起合作？成功的概率会更大一些。”祖安顺势招揽。
周瑜微微摇头拒绝：“虽然我看好你，但我不能放过任何其他的可能。”
祖安默然，对方这才是最理性的办法，化身谋士辅佐每一个枭雄，不管谁吃鸡赢了，他都是最后的胜利者。
周瑜拱了拱手，告辞离去。
而卢植已经扶着乔玄乐呵呵地出来了：“玄德，还不快快来拜见岳父。”
祖安又惊又喜，也不知道卢植是怎么说服他的，急忙上前行了一礼。
“拜见岳父大人！”
乔玄脸色有些不好看：“哼，还没有成亲，这声岳父我可不敢当。”
卢植哈哈一笑：“玄德你别介意，乔公其实很欣赏你，不然也不会同意，只是因为你一下子薅走了他两个宝贝女儿，心中难免有些不舍。”
乔玄这才面色稍缓，心平气和考察了他一些学识以及对当今朝局的见解，见对方对答如流，不由欣慰地点了点头。
接下来卢植跟乔玄商议三媒六聘之事，祖安则找了个机会偷偷溜到后花园中。
商留鱼和宫素音坐在凉亭中，似乎正笑着聊着什么，看得出两人心情都很不错。
注意到祖安的到来，两女似笑非笑地望着他，她们分坐两边，那神情仿佛在看他到底选择先去哪边。
祖安根本没有选，大大咧咧坐到了两女中间：“没想到你们竟然成了姐妹，我们还以这种方式相见。”
content_en:
Lu Zhi thought to himself that my daughter has been attached to him for a long time. If I hadn't stopped her, I would have been privately engaged for life.
What kind of magic power does Xuande have...
Of course, he didn't show it on his face. Instead, he said with a smile: "The two sisters fell in love with each other. It will be a good story in the history books in the future."
Qiao Xuan looked ugly, glared at his two daughters, and told them to go back to the inner house first.
The two sisters were in a good mood when they reunited with Zu An, but they did not contradict their father again.
Qiao Xuan glanced at Zu An, and then took Lu Zhi to the study to discuss.
Only Zu An and Zhou Yu were left in the hall.
Zu An felt moved and took the initiative to strike up a conversation: "The Sun family and his son have left. Is Gong Jin staying here to wait for me?"
"You're quite thick-skinned," Zhou Yu smiled, "How did you know it was me."
Zu An smiled and said: "Before, you said that you would transform into thousands of people and become a resourceful person who assists all forces. Naturally, Zhou Yu is the one who should be by the side of the Sun family and his son."
The guy in front of me is naturally one of the incarnations of the God of Wisdom.
"Yes, I did stay to talk to you. Big and small Qiao actually fell in love with you. It seems that you are really lucky. Maybe what I said before will really succeed in you." Zhou Yu said with emotion.
"In that case, why don't you and I work together? The probability of success will be greater." Zu An took advantage of the opportunity to recruit.
Zhou Yu shook his head slightly and refused: "Although I am optimistic about you, I cannot let go of any other possibility."
Zu An was silent, this was the most rational approach for the opponent, transforming into a counselor to assist every hero. No matter who wins the chicken game, he will be the final winner.
Zhou Yu bowed his hands, said goodbye and left.
Lu Zhi had already supported Qiao Xuan and came out happily: "Xuande, come and see your father-in-law quickly."
Zu An was surprised and happy. He didn't know how Lu Zhi persuaded him, so he hurriedly stepped forward and bowed.
"Greetings to my father-in-law!"
Qiao Xuan's face looked a little ugly: "Humph, we haven't gotten married yet, so I don't dare to call you father-in-law."
Lu Zhi laughed: "Xuande, don't mind. In fact, Mr. Qiao admires you very much, otherwise he wouldn't agree. It's just because you took away his two precious daughters at once, it's inevitable that he feels a little reluctant to let go."
Qiao Xuan's face softened a little, and he calmly examined some of his knowledge and opinions on the current situation. Seeing that the other party answered fluently, he couldn't help but nodded with pleasure.
Next, Lu Zhi and Qiao Xuan discussed the matter of three matchmakers and six appointments, while Zu An found an opportunity to sneak into the back garden.
Shang Liuyu and Gong Suyin were sitting in the pavilion, seeming to be laughing and chatting about something. It was obvious that both of them were in a good mood.
Noticing Zu An's arrival, the two women looked at him with half-smiling smiles. They sat on opposite sides, as if they were watching which side he would choose to go to first.
Zu An had no choice at all, and calmly sat down between the two women: "I didn't expect that you would become sisters, and we would meet each other in this way."
